name: Take and Hold mirror A - suggested deployment
intent: The Nightbringer, Skorpekhs, Skorpekh Lord, and Ammentar form one compact missile group on the right. The Nightbringer occupies the frontmost legal pocket available to its full 90mm base while remaining completely clear of every terrain footprint. Both Wraith bricks and the Skorpekhs touch terrain for cover. The Reanimator remains hidden clear of the blue home ruin. One Flayed One unit infiltrates behind the centre ruin without touching it; the second screens the right rear. The Void Dragon starts in deep strike.

nightbringer.note: Frontmost legal pocket for the right-hand missile group. The full 90mm base, plus a verified 0.30in safety buffer, is clear of every terrain footprint.

ammentar.note: Packed beside the Nightbringer and 2.81in from the nearest Skorpekh base for the compact missile group and Lone Operative protection.

skorpekh-lord.note: Packed between the Nightbringer, Ammentar, and the Skorpekh column while remaining attached to the Destroyers.

technomancer-veil.note: Attached to Wraith unit 1 in the open pocket of the left terrain area.

technomancer.note: Attached to Wraith unit 2 in the blue home ruin.

reanimator.note: Behind the south corner of the blue home ruin, not touching its footprint.

wraiths-left.note: Forward around the left terrain area with every Wraith base touching the footprint for cover.

wraiths-centre.note: Forward in the open middle of the blue home ruin, clear of its walls.

flayed-ones.note: Infiltrate behind the centre ruin without touching its footprint.

skorpekhs.note: Forward column along the right edge of the blue home ruin. The middle pair steps inward to clear the Nightbringer's forward 90mm base while the unit remains on the terrain footprint for cover.
